name: co.elastic.otel.android.internal.features.clock.ElasticClockBroadcastReceiver
description: After Android reports that the device has booted, the Elastic OpenTelemetry agent clears its saved clock offset so later telemetry can recalibrate its timestamps.
disableEffect: After a device restart, Elastic telemetry may keep a stale clock correction until it is recalibrated.
